title.narrative: Science, Technology and Innovation for Water, Biodiversity and Climate Action

description.narrative: This integrated initiative will advance science, technology and innovation (STI) for sustainable development in South-East Europe by linking water resource management, biodiversity conservation, and climate action within a coherent regional framework. It will position UNESCO-designated sites, transboundary water systems, and local innovation ecosystems as interconnected platforms for resilience, knowledge generation, and policy impact. Through regional dialogue, capacity development, and targeted knowledge products, the programme will strengthen science–policy interfaces, enhance access to climate and biodiversity finance, and promote cooperative water governance. At the same time, it will support open and inclusive innovation by fostering grassroots and frugal technologies that address local environmental challenges. By connecting research, policy, and practice, and engaging youth, institutions, and communities, the initiative will enable evidence-based decision-making, scalable solutions, and stronger regional cooperation, contributing to the SDGs, the Paris Agreement, and the Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.
